Connection Series Panel Discussion

What Aotearoa New Zealand will be like in 2050 is up to us.   

Our first National Strategy Connection Series event will delve into what key demographic shifts could mean for the country’s future wellbeing. Hear from a panel of thought leaders made up of academics, economists, policy and community experts as they discuss what the next 25 years could bring and how the decisions we make today will impact tomorrow.  

Panellists will respond to the key trends from Stats NZ and Treasury data to imagine a future in which everyone in Aotearoa New Zealand has access to rewarding and meaningful participation in society, contributes to sustainable growth, and experiences a stable retirement.

Our great panel of speakers includes: 
- Susan Livingood, Director of Sustainability and Financial Inclusion, Te Pūtea Matua Reserve Bank of New Zealand
- Steve Armitage, CEO, Hospitality NZ 
- Dr Patrick Nolan, Director of Policy and Research, Te Ara Ahunga Ora Retirement Commission 
- Lillian Grace, Founder, Figure NZ, Co-Founder of Victory & Grace

Access and Choice programme at 5 years webinar, 16 April 2025

Te Hiringa Mahara hosted a webinar outlining key findings from our new, independent report: Access and Choice Programme: Monitoring report on progress and achievements at five years. The report was released on 3 April 2025 and provides an overview of the implementation of Access and Choice,  primary mental health care programme. 

Our expert panel discussed their experiences with the programme from the perspectives of lived experience, Kaupapa Māori services, and the workforce.   

Our speakers are:
- Carole Koha, Pou kaihautu, Te Waka Whaiora Porirua and Te Menenga Pai Newtown. 
- Leilani Maraku, Manukura (Chief Executive), Mana o te Tangata Trust. 
Genevieve Obbeek, Health Improvement Practitioner, WellSouth Primary Health Network
- Kerri Kruse, Senior Policy Analyst, Te Hiringa Mahara.

The session was co-hosted by Maraea Johns, Kaitohu Hauora Māori | Director Māori Health; and Sonya Russell, Kaiwhakahaere Hauora Hinengaro, Waranga | Director Mental Health and Addiction Sector Leadership, Te Hiringa Mahara. 

Read the full report: www.mhwc.govt.nz/access-choice-2025

Find out more about the progreamme:  https://www.wellbeingsupport.health.nz/

The first 5 years of the Access and Choice Programme - Karen Orsborn, CEO

On Thursday 3 April, the Mental Health and Wellbeing Commission will publish Access and Choice Programme: Monitoring report on progress and achievements at five years report.
